caption: The image depicts a round ceramic plate with a detailed monochrome illustration in the center and a decorative border around the rim. The central illustration shows a large building with a domed roof, surrounded by smaller buildings and several tall spires, likely representing a cityscape. In the foreground in front of the building, there are small figures of people walking, some in pairs or groups, and a horse-drawn carriage with two horses and a driver. There are a few scattered trees, and the sky has stylized clouds. The rim of the plate is bordered by a repeating pattern of large flowers and leaves interspersed with clusters of round fruit, rendered in a similar monochromatic palette. The entire design is rendered in shades of dark gray and white.
title: Plate - "Exchange, Baltimore"
